findings.title: Hardcoded Fallback JWT Secret in Middleware & Session
findings.impact: Privilege escalation to SUPERADMIN if JWT_SECRET environment variable is missing
findings.recommendation: Throw unrecoverable error in production if JWT_SECRET is unset; disallow fallback

findings.title: Hardcoded VAPID Private Key in Source Code
findings.impact: Unauthorized actors can sign and broadcast fraudulent push notifications to all users
findings.recommendation: Remove fallback private key literal from source code; require process.env.VAPID_PRIVATE_KEY

findings.title: Missing Content-Security-Policy & Strict-Transport-Security Headers
findings.impact: Vulnerability to MITM attacks, script injection, and clickjacking in permissive contexts
findings.recommendation: Configure production HSTS, CSP, COOP, and CORP headers in next.config.mjs

findings.title: In-Memory Rate Limiting Incompatible with Multi-Instance Serverless
findings.impact: Attackers can bypass brute-force limits across distributed serverless lambda instances
findings.recommendation: Migrate to Upstash Redis or PostgreSQL atomic rate limiting

findings.title: Sensitive API Secret Accepted via URL Query Parameter
findings.impact: CRON_SECRET token is logged in access logs, proxy caches, and Referer headers
findings.recommendation: Require Authorization: Bearer <token> and reject query parameter tokens in production

findings.title: Ephemeral Local Storage & Unbounded 5MB Base64 DB Fallback
findings.impact: Database bloat (~28 GB per 100 active cohort members) and high connection latency
findings.recommendation: Connect Cloud Object Storage (S3 / Cloudflare R2 / Supabase Storage) with direct URLs

findings.title: Orphan Image File Accumulation on Account Deletion
findings.recommendation: Add deletion hook or storage lifecycle rule for old user media

findings.title: Service Worker 60ms Timeout Infinite Navigation Reload Loop Risk
findings.impact: Infinite page reload loops and screen flickering on high-latency mobile networks
findings.recommendation: Remove synthetic 60ms timeout race; implement standard network-first with offline fallback

findings.title: Missing Dedicated Offline Fallback Page and Incomplete Manifest Scope
findings.impact: Broken white screen when navigating offline; omitted explicit PWA scope
findings.recommendation: Add public/offline.html precached on install; add scope: '/' to manifest.json

findings.title: Client-Triggered Global Platform Notification Dispatch Loop with N+1 Queries
findings.impact: Database connection pool starvation on PgBouncer and duplicate push notifications
findings.recommendation: Isolate notification dispatch strictly to server-side cron with advisory locks

findings.title: Monolithic Server Component Serialization on Member Dashboard
findings.impact: Bloated initial SSR HTML document payload degrading TTFB and mobile hydration
findings.recommendation: Paginate or defer non-active program curriculum queries to client-side on-demand fetch

findings.title: Monolithic Client Component Complexity (AdminClient.tsx 11,719 Lines)
findings.impact: High cognitive complexity, slow HMR compile times, large monolithic client bundle (58.6 kB)
findings.recommendation: Refactor AdminClient into modular sub-tabs loaded with next/dynamic

findings.title: PgBouncer Connection Pool Starvation Risk with connection_limit=1
findings.impact: Connection acquisition timeouts under concurrent checkouts or interactive transactions
findings.recommendation: Increase connection_limit to 5-10 and keep interactive transactions minimal

findings.title: sharp Misplaced in devDependencies Instead of Runtime Dependencies
findings.impact: Missing sharp in pruned production containers causes slower image optimization and high CPU load
findings.recommendation: Move sharp to dependencies in package.json

findings.title: Absence of Centralized Observability & Error Tracking
findings.impact: No structured logging, APM metrics, or Sentry error capture for live incident diagnosis
findings.recommendation: Integrate Sentry and structured JSON logger with correlation IDs

findings.title: Test Suite Coupling to Remote Production DB & Missing Automated CI Pipeline
findings.impact: npm test fails in isolated sandbox or CI without live internet/database; no GitHub Actions
findings.recommendation: Install Vitest with mocked Prisma client; configure .github/workflows/ci.yml

findings.title: Obsolete SQLite Database File Left in Repository
Unused Legacy Push Notification Integration Stub
